title: Autonomous investigation of radical carbonylation and amine selectivity
difficulty_reasons: Requires proposing, generating, prioritizing, and discriminating competing elementary pathways and multiple transition-state approaches.
Coverage and stopping must be justified across four chemically distinct amine channels.

paper.title: Metal-free visible-light carbonylation of alkyl iodides to amides via consecutive photoinduced electron transfer

data.description: Explicit SMILES, charge, multiplicity, roles, and model boundary for every molecular participant.

required_deliverables.description: Independent pathway investigation, validated candidate results, energies, and conclusion.
